notes.title: 'Gods of Havoc: Fall to Earth' Launches
notes.content:
I'm pleased announce the release of 'Fall to Earth' the second instalment in the 'God's of Havoc' trilogy. Another chance to play a classically styled, god game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120770/Gods_of_Havoc_Fall_to_Earth/

Help guide your chosen people to victory by bestowing blessings upon them, and by smiting their enemies.

notes.title: Gods of Havoc - Trilogy
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35397735/784fd00bc6fd1e4322fac50b082b368a3687936b.png[/img]

[h1]Gods of Havoc heralds a return to the classic God-Game.[/h1]

Gods of Havoc is a three-part series offering difficult, turn-based strategy. Each game places the player as a god in different eras of a planet’s history.
 
[list]
[*] Fall to Earth: takes place in an early medieval setting;
[*] After the Fall: takes place in a post-apocalyptic one;
[*] Into the Void: takes place in a galactic scale.
[/list]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1117340/Gods_of_Havoc_Into_the_Void/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1120770/Gods_of_Havoc_Fall_to_Earth/
 
‘Fall to Earth’ and ‘Into the Void’, are set to be released in August 2019 with ‘After the Fall’ to be released in December 2019.

Don't forget to wishlist for more news on all three games! Visit https://www.gods-of-havoc.com/ for more information!

notes.title: Void Monsters - 20% off this weekend!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/807060/Void_Monsters_Spring_City_Tales/

Hoping to escape your destiny as a monster trainer you left the home of your famous parents to find your own way in the world. 

Within two years of leaving home your parents had been murdered and now you've been called back to inherit their failing farm.

With the farm heavily in debt to the bank, and with a burning desire to find and kill your parents' murderer the only option is to take up the mantle of monster trainer and the destiny you tried so hard to escape.


Features:
-A huge open world to explore.
-Nearly 100 unique monsters to collect, train, and evolve. 
-Choose from 10 playable characters.
-A dynamic economy influenced by your choices.
-Break into, and steal from, any house, shop, or warehouse.
-A massive crafting system with hundreds of craftable items.
-Hundreds of quests including an immense main storyline.
-Multiple ways to proceed and complete the game.
-40 hours of scripted gameplay and the chance to play on indefinitely!
-A battle arena to challenge other monster trainers.
-Breed goats on your farm for milk, to craft battle cheeses and magical yogurts.
-An advanced weapon and armour socketing system.

notes.title: News, and Void Monsters Release!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/807060/Void_Monsters_Spring_City_Tales/

The launch of Void Monsters sees the completion of our new engine. With that comes a release date for Fortunes Tavern 2 (a free update for all FT owners.), July 2018. After that we plan to re-release both Star-Box and Apocalypse hotel using this far better engine, and of course, they will be free to all previous owners. While you are waiting on that, why not give Void Monsters a try, and see how far the engine has progressed.

Thanks to all the beta testers from our previous games and for all the fantastic comments on our forums.

notes.title: 'Unhappy Ever After' - Kickstarter Launch
notes.content:
You may know that we are porting this game (and our others) to a new engine, which will be free for all of you who already have bought them. The new engine is amazing but I've needed a lot of help in beginning the process.

A friend over at Warped Tales has been a great help and so I'm happy to share with you their first [url=store.steampowered.com] Kickstarter Project[/url] which they've just launched.

Please take a [url=store.steampowered.com]look at their page[/url] and consider donating - you can get the game for under half price if you are an early adopter!

Also, please consider checking out their Greenlight page and upvoting them. I believe they definitely deserve it!

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=735825714

notes.title: DLC Cheat Pack! - A lazy way to play more characters!
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/447300?beta=0

Tired of hunting around the city, trying to find characters to unlock? Then this pack is for you!

This pack will unlock 5 additional starting characters for the game, without you having to locate them first. The characters are:

1. Alice Wazcheck
   A very fit yoga teacher who starts with 20 extra snacks! She begins the game to the far right of the map, near the mayor's mansion.

2. Joan Dartsmith
   A sewage worker who starts in the sewers directly beneath the gunshop, oh yeah! She also gets a sewer access card!

3. Clive Mackersdonger
   Starts with a hospital key-card and just outside the Eastern entrance to the hospital. 

4. Hannah Greatford
   A car mechanic that starts with the fuel siphoner. A great character for crafting as she's never short on fuel!

5. Roger Grubberwick
   Poor old Roger! Not much better than the starting characters but does get a lot of random crafting supplies to start with.

Even with these characters unlocked you still get the fun of locating the last 3, and best, starting characters, although it will be much easier now you have access to new parts of the map! Good Luck!

notes.title: Apocalypse Hotel - The Post-Apocalyptic Hotel Simulator!
notes.content:
’24 Hours ‘til Rescue’ is a survival game based on the excellent engine created by FlynnFour Games, used in ‘Apocalypse Hotel: The Post-Apocalyptic Hotel Simulator’ – We loved that game so much that we built this one based on it, albeit in a very different genre!

If you are not a fan of our survival, permadeath, super difficult game you may wish to check out there easier, but no less fun, game where you get to build up a hotel after the apocalypse!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/423700/

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 [Movement and camera fixes]
notes.content:
1. The 'smooth scrolling' script has been removed. The camera now moves with the player instead of slowly following behind.

2. The character no longer takes a second to turn and move from a stopped position.

3. Strafe has been quickened.
